notes: One public service operation is counted once regardless of its Flask/CLI callers. Interface mappings include their shared local helper calls and capability reads.

move_field delegates to replace_order; Dataset context/details reads delegate to their existing read services. Composite writes are described in the matrix, not counted as independent bulk operations.
GrantService has no current HTTP/CLI administration endpoint; it remains a supported programmatic service for legacy and non-Dataset resources.

Pure validators, serializers, ORM CRUD ports/adapters and parser helpers are implementation mechanisms, not independent business entrypoints. Their owning service/administrative operation is classified.

No background business worker, API credentials, publication/versioning, Dataset deletion or authenticated business API exists. Alembic upgrade/downgrade is the operator migration capability, not user history.

implicit_interfaces.reason: Packaged static assets; no business read or mutation.

implicit_interfaces.symbol: Flask HEAD for GET and OPTIONS
implicit_interfaces.reason: HEAD executes the corresponding GET handler (including export request auditing); automatic OPTIONS returns routing metadata only.
Default framework documentation routes remain disabled. REF-109 publishes only the explicitly inventoried /api documentation routes.

implicit_interfaces.symbol: Browser transport, CSRF, request-size and exception hooks
implicit_interfaces.reason: Apply to all applicable protected forms/import/login requests; failures have REF-31 disposition and no success audit.
